super_admin.name: Super Admin
super_admin.description: Provides unrestricted access to all resources, operations, and administrative settings.

all_reader.name: All Reader
all_reader.description: Provides read-only access to all resources and operations.

all_writer.name: All Writer
all_writer.description: Provides read and write access to all resources, including users and secrets. Actions restricted to super_admin, such as changing settings or user roles, are not included.

event_ingestor.name: Event Ingestor
event_ingestor.description: Provides write-only access to event ingestion. Intended for services that only submit events.

event_reader.name: Event Reader
event_reader.description: Provides read-only access to events. Intended for services that only consume or inspect events.
